book.name: MULUM PASA
book.title: MULUM PASA Kuate tuku mulum pasa Mosesŋge kuyarna

content: Kuate nu Abram ndoŋ wamdus ulendinaik
Mara ande Abram nu kiŋatanu suk Suŋgoŋge wika sana: Abram, ne kuru kuru ndaka. Ye ne tuku kandim taŋaŋ ne kulatka minet. Ne lafu mayenu suŋgokanu tamŋgat ŋgina.
Taŋakina le Abram nu ndek sana: O Kuate Suŋgo, ye kiŋo kugatok minet. Ye kumi le Damaskusnu taŋgo Elieser nuŋge ye tuku agaŋ ndende kilamŋgat. Ta tuku ne ame agaŋ mayenu ye samŋgat?
Ne ye tuku ndare tumunu ande ndasina tukunu ye tuku kukul taŋgo nuŋge ye tuku agaŋ ndende kilamŋgat ŋgina.
Taŋakina le Suŋgo nu pasa lafumba sana: Kuga. Kukul taŋgo naŋe Elieser nu ne tuku agaŋ ndende kile nda. Naŋe kiŋo ndinok ta nuŋge ne tuku agaŋ ndende kilamŋgat ŋgina.

Taŋakina sulumba nu Abram tumba kilim kumba sana: Ai ambe. Samba mbol ambe tandeka mambilmba mbai kaŋgerka. Ne ŋakmba burkam kumuŋ e? Ŋgumneŋga ne tuku ndare mbolŋge mbuŋ gudommba mayok kaŋgaig. Samba mbolŋge mbai minig taŋaŋ burnu kumuŋ kuga ŋgina.
Taŋakina le Abram nu Suŋgo tuku pasa ta ismba nu tuku saŋgri tomba tiŋgina le Suŋgo nu tuku ŋgamuŋgal son ta kaŋgermba nu taŋgo tiŋreknu ŋgina.
Taŋakina sulumba nu Abram sana: Ye Suŋgo. Ye ne Babilonia mbal tuku kilke Ur tumbraŋŋge ye ne mindenumba te prowen. Kilke te ne sernam tuku ŋga ye taŋawen ŋgina le
Abram ndek lafumba sakina: O Kuate Suŋgo, ye kilke te miro minam tuku sayate ta ye ndaŋmba pasa ta son pasa ŋga kila pili e ŋgina le

Kuate nu ndek sana: Agaŋmor afu kilmba ye tugum te prowa. Makau paŋgarnu ande, meme paŋgarnu ande, sipsip pailnu ande ŋakmba yar keŋmba ŋak, gami ande, sar umaŋ kitek ande turmba kilmba ye tugum te prowa ŋgina le
Abram nu pasa ta kumumba agaŋmor ta kilmba nu tugum prona sulumba agaŋmor ta ŋgamuŋge fetke lika inumnu ndinamŋge inumnu ŋaiŋamŋge patike likina sulumba umaŋ armba ta fet ndakina.
Taŋana le wir afu ndem ta kilam tuku fumba ndekinaig le Abram nu ndem ta ŋgailka nane yokerke likina.
Ki ka butuŋgina le Abram nu kinymba ma make suŋgo kaŋgermba ŋgamuŋgal pitina le nu kuru kuru suŋgo tina.

Taŋamba minna le Suŋgo nu Abram sana: Ye siŋka sanet. Ne tuku mbuŋ kilke te kusremba kilke kise mbolŋge rawe taŋgo minwaig le kilke ta mbolok mbal nane piro kareŋnu niŋguwaig le piroka nane ait kuen ŋayo yar 400 nane sanzalnu minamŋgaig.
Ait ta kugawa le ye kilke ta mbolok mbal lafumba piti niŋgi le naŋe mbuŋ kame kusrekuwaig le agaŋ ndende suŋgomba ŋak tiŋga ma ta kusrewamŋgaig.
Neŋge ndo mine mayemba ma ma saibo pilmba kuma le ŋgunuŋgaig.
Amor mbal kilke te mbolŋge minig ta naŋgine mbar sugo ke likade ta kumuŋguwaig le naŋe ndare pulumba kinit ta ka bailkanu mbolŋge maŋ luka te prowamŋgaig ŋga Abram sana.
Taŋakina le ki butuŋga furirna le waim ande pa guwa ŋak sati ande turmba mayok kinaik sulumba agaŋmor ndemnu Abrahamŋge fetka patikina ta ŋgamuk ŋgamuk kinaik.

Taŋanaik le Suŋgo nu Abram ndoŋ wamdus ulendika siŋka son pasa Abram sana: Ne tuku ndare ye kilke te serniŋgamŋgit. Isip tuku kule suŋgo kumamŋge kumba ka kule suŋgo Yufretis kumamŋge tiŋgate kilke ta ŋakmba tane sertiŋgamŋgit.
Ken mbal Kenis mbal Kadmon mbal Hit mbal Peris mbal Refaim mbal Amor mbal Kanan mbal Girkas mbal Yebus mbal nane tuku kilke ta ŋakmba tane sertiŋgamŋgit ŋga Abram sana.
